entities.name: Timer T3481
entities.description: Timer used during UE requested bearer resource modification procedure. Controls retransmission of BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST messages.

entities.name: UE requested bearer resource modification procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to modify bearer resources. Can be aborted due to timer expiry or collision with other procedures.

entities.name: BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to request modification of bearer resources. Retransmitted on T3481 expiry.

entities.name: BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REJECT
entities.description: Message received by UE rejecting bearer resource modification request. Contains ESM cause values.

entities.name: DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST
entities.description: Message received by UE to deactivate EPS bearer context. Can collide with bearer resource modification procedure.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to synchronize EPS bearer context status with MME. Includes EPS bearer context status IE.

entities.name: EPS bearer context status IE
entities.description: Information element included in TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message to synchronize bearer context status with MME.

entities.name: PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE
entities.description: State entered by UE after aborting bearer resource modification procedure on fifth T3481 expiry.

entities.name: Fifth expiry of timer T3481
entities.description: Condition that triggers abortion of bearer resource modification procedure and transition to PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE state.

entities.name: ESM cause #43 invalid EPS bearer identity
entities.description: Condition in BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REJECT message indicating unknown EPS bearer context.

entities.name: ESM cause #31 request rejected, unspecified
entities.description: Condition in BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REJECT message triggering local bearer deactivation.

entities.name: Local EPS bearer context deactivation
entities.description: Behavior where UE deactivates EPS bearer context locally without peer-to-peer signaling with MME.

relations.description: UE requested bearer resource modification procedure starts timer T3481.
Procedure includes sending BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST message.
Fifth expiry of T3481 causes UE to enter PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE state.
ESM cause #43 triggers local EPS bearer context deactivation.
ESM cause #31 triggers local EPS bearer context deactivation.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message contains EPS bearer context status IE.
BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REJECT message can contain ESM cause #43 condition.
BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REJECT message can contain ESM cause #31 condition.
DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message stops UE requested bearer resource modification procedure.
Local EPS bearer context deactivation stops timer T3481.
